items.title_zh: 平台化情感退缩：安静退出和拒绝 TikTok 上的性别情感劳动

items.abstract_excerpt: This article situates Substack within the platformisation of blogging and the enclosure of cultural production within proprietary infrastructures. items.title: Self-programmable creative labour: Generative AI and the reorganisation of work in the UK creative industries
items.abstract_excerpt: Generative artificial intelligence (AI) is increasingly entering creative work not only as a set of tools, but as a new demand placed on creative practitioners. items.title_zh: 自编程创意劳动：生成人工智能和英国创意产业的工作重组
items.abstract_excerpt_zh: 生成人工智能（AI）越来越多地进入创意工作，不仅作为一套工具，而且作为对创意从业者的新要求。 现有关于创意产业人工智能的争论往往集中在生产力、创造力或作者身份上。 虽然很重要，但这种框架有可能将人工智能视为一种离散的技术干预，而不是更广泛的创造性劳动重组的一部分。借鉴…

items.title: From ephemeral acts to agency pathways: A life-course approach to user agency in platform societies
items.abstract_excerpt: I argue in this paper that debates about user agency in platform societies have become stuck between two unsatisfactory positions: the tendency to treat everyday acts of agency as evidence of empowerment, and the tendency to dismiss such acts as inconsequential in the face of platform power. items.title_zh: 从短暂行为到代理途径：平台社会中用户代理的生命周期方法

items.title: Public construction of evidence: Rethinking scientific evidence in social media environments
items.abstract_excerpt: This essay proposes a conceptual framework that reconceptualizes scientific evidence as a process of public construction in contemporary media environments. In social media contexts, scientists, journalists, influencers, NGOs, lay publics and AI agents participate in the circulation and interpretation of evidential claims. items.title_zh: 证据的公共构建：重新思考社交媒体环境中的科学证据

items.title: Climate Change Disinformation| Seeking the Truth Among Dead Crops: Carbon Footprint Victimhood, Platformed Conspiracism, and Climate Countermovement in Turkey
items.abstract_excerpt: After years of climate inaction, Turkey’s ratification of the Paris Agreement in 2021 prompted the Justice and Development Party’s discursive shift from high-carbon hegemonic agenda to green developmentalist rhetoric. items.title: Climate Change Disinformation| Harvesting Denial: Mapping Primary and Secondary Climate Obstruction in Brazil
items.abstract_excerpt: This study conducts a qualitative, exploratory investigation of climate obstruction in Brazil. items.abstract_excerpt: Populist parties are gaining popularity among young voters in many Western democracies. Young voters increasingly obtain news online through social media websites. items.abstract_excerpt_zh: 这篇评论对网络安全中的“修复力量”及其对技术民主的更广泛影响进行了一些思考。我首先讨论解决方案主义的话语与保护 IT 系统安全的日常实践之间的差异（Elgaard Jensen 等人，2026）。前者认为问题很简单并且可以通过技术解决，而后者必须面对 Röhle（2021）所说的……

items.title: Digital responsibility, skills and environmental awareness for digital sustainability
items.abstract_excerpt: This study investigates how digital competencies and environmental awareness interact to shape eco-friendly digital practices, contributing to the field of digital sustainability. Drawing on a representative sample of adult internet users in the United Arab Emirates (N = 1016), it explores (H1) whether individual responsibility predicts environmentally conscious digital practices; (H2) whether environmental awareness moderates the effect of…
items.title_zh: 数字可持续发展的数字责任、技能和环境意识
items.abstract_excerpt_zh: 这项研究调查了数字能力和环境意识如何相互作用，以塑造生态友好的数字实践，为数字可持续发展领域做出贡献。利用阿拉伯联合酋长国成年互联网用户的代表性样本（N = 1016），它探讨了（H1）个人责任是否预示着环保意识的数字实践； (H2) 环境意识是否会调节……的影响

items.title: Guidance over guidelines? Unpacking the uses and concerns of generative AI in communication science
items.abstract_excerpt: The rapid adoption of generative Artificial Intelligence (genAI) tools has transformed research practices across communication science. As genAI tools (and most notetably large language models), made the generation of text, images, and other media content extremely easy, they can potentially disrupt the way science is conducted. Yet, their integration into academic workflows has outpaced systematic understanding of how, when, and why…
items.title_zh: 指导高于指导方针？解析生成式人工智能在通信科学中的用途和关注点
items.abstract_excerpt_zh: 生成人工智能（genAI）工具的快速采用改变了传播科学的研究实践。由于 genAI 工具（尤其是大型语言模型）使文本、图像和其他媒体内容的生成变得极其容易，因此它们可能会破坏科学的进行方式。然而，它们与学术工作流程的整合速度已经超过了对如何、何时以及为何……的系统理解。

items.abstract_excerpt: Feelings of irritation often emerge in romantic relationships. However, the theoretical mechanisms predicting whether individuals disclose these feelings to their romantic partner remain limited and largely reliant on examining indicators of future behavior rather than actual future behavior. items.title_zh: 预测浪漫关系中的恼怒披露：测试和扩展揭露风险模型
items.abstract_excerpt_zh: 恋爱关系中经常会出现恼怒的感觉。然而，预测个人是否向其浪漫伴侣透露这些感受的理论机制仍然有限，并且在很大程度上依赖于检查未来行为指标而不是实际的未来行为。当前的研究采用了一项涉及 448 名参与者的为期两个月的纵向调查设计，测试了启示风险模型 (RRM) 作为……的机制。

items.abstract_excerpt: This paper draws together insights from political science and political communication to advance a new understanding of the role of media in democratic backsliding and resilience. items.abstract_excerpt: This article develops the concept of convergent hybrid media accountability (CHMA) to explain how informal digital criticism is translated into institutional consequence in Morocco’s hybrid media environment.
